name: emberlink
description: Zero-knowledge one-time secret sharing for API keys, passwords and other confidential text.

scripts.build: npm run build -w @emberlink/web && npm run build -w @emberlink/server
scripts.start:phone: npm run build && PORT=8080 NODE_ENV=production TLS_KEY_FILE=certs/key.pem TLS_CERT_FILE=certs/cert.pem npm run start -w @emberlink/server
scripts.test: npm run test -w @emberlink/web && npm run test -w @emberlink/server
